transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose things have just been getting to me lately. They, uh... they changed my hours at the warehouse. Put in some new inventory system. 

Ever since then, I just... I don't know, I feel like I'm falling apart. I've been missing shifts. Missing church, too. Snapping at my family over nothing. Some mornings I just sit there in my work boots and... just wonder if I can even face the place anymore.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
I don't know about anxious. Not really. I just... I don't know. I haven't really thought about it like that. Just what I told you.
Have you been feeling sad lately?
I don't... no. Not sad. I'm not sitting around crying or anything like that. Just... I don't know. Just what I said before. It's just hard to get out the door.
Have you been enjoying things you normally like to do?
I guess I haven't really been doing much of anything. Just... sitting around mostly. Like I said, I haven't been going to church. I don't really have the energy for much else.
Do you find pleasure in the things you're doing, even if it's just a little?
I don't really... I don't know about pleasure. I'm just passing the time, mostly. I haven't really paid much attention to it.
Do you feel nervous or on edge most of the time?
No... not really. I wouldn't say I feel nervous. Just... I don't know. Just quiet, mostly.
Do you feel guilty about anything?
No... I don't think so. There's nothing to feel guilty about, really. I just... no.
Do you find yourself looking forward to things that you used to enjoy?
Not really. I don't... I haven't really thought about what's coming up. Just taking it one day at a time, I guess. So, no.
Are you avoiding certain places or situations because of how you're feeling?
No... I don't think so. I just go to work and come home. I don't really go anywhere else to begin with, so... no.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure in things?
I don't know. I wouldn't say unable... I just haven't really been paying attention to that kind of thing. Just doing what I need to do, I guess.
Do you feel like things that used to be fun are not fun anymore?
I couldn't really tell you. I... I don't do a whole lot of fun things to begin with. Just... work, mostly. So I haven't really noticed.
Have you been trying not to think about something that happened to you?
No. I don't really know what you mean by that. I just... I just go to work. I don't really think about much else.
Are there any specific things or situations that you've been avoiding because of how you've been feeling lately?
No. Not really. I just... I do my shift, and I go home. There's not much else to avoid, I guess.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to care about?
I don't... not really. Like I said, I just work. There wasn't a whole lot I was doing anyway, so... I haven't really noticed a difference. Just trying to get through the week, I guess.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
No. I don't really pay attention to that. I guess my clothes fit about the same, so... no, I haven't noticed anything.
Are you avoiding your workplace or anything related to your job because of the changes they made?

I guess... yeah, maybe a little. I mean, ever since they changed my hours and put in that new inventory system... I just feel like I'm falling apart. I've been missing shifts. Some mornings I just sit there in my boots, wondering if I can even face going in. I've missed church stuff too, and... I've been snapping at my family. It's just... a lot.
Have you been trying to avoid thinking about the changes at your workplace or anything related to that situation?
I don't know. Not really. It's... kind of hard to avoid thinking about it, honestly. It's just always there.
Are you trying to avoid thinking about the warehouse or your job when you're not working?
I... I think I just said that. No. I don't really try to block it out or anything. It's just... always on my mind, even when I'm home.
Do you feel like your difficulties with work and daily life are causing you a lot of distress?
Yeah... it is. I mean, it's hard. I don't really know what else to say about it. It just... it wears on you.
Do you feel like your difficulties are interfering with your relationships with family or friends?

I suppose. I've... stepped back from some things at church. Duties that people were counting on me for, I just... haven't been doing them. And... well, my supervisor at work noticed too. He documented some issues with my reliability lately. He even brought up me taking a medical leave. So... I guess it is interfering, yes.
